data.name: Gacha Shop Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Gacha Shop Simulator is a collectible shop simulation where you sell blind boxes and gachapons, hunt for rare figures, and build your business while feeding your collecting obsession.

Open Them Yourself
Crack open blind boxes and crank gachapons in person, with satisfying unboxing animations and the moment each figure makes its debut. Big figures from blind boxes, mini ones from capsules — just like real life.

Hunt Across Dozens of Series
Collect across roughly 25 blind box series and 25 gachapon series, each with its own common, rare, and secret figures. A pity system guarantees the big drops come eventually — sell rares for profit or keep them to complete your collection.

Manage Your Shop
Design and expand your store, arrange shelves and themed display zones, and stock blind boxes, gachapons, comics, and action figures. Watch demand trends and adjust prices to match ever-changing customer tastes.

Trade and Grow
Trade figures with NPCs to land unique and hidden editions you can't get from regular stock. Reinvest your profits to expand your space, unlock new series, and attract even more customers.

If you love simulation, collecting, and trendy toys — Gacha Shop Simulator delivers endless unboxing joy!

data.short_description: A cozy shop-management and collecting sim. Stock and sell blind boxes and gachapons, open them yourself for the thrill of every unboxing, hunt rare and secret figures across dozens of series, set prices to match shifting demand, trade with customers, and expand your shop into a collector's paradise.
